protected_invariants: ZERO_PROVIDER_CONTACT: candidate preparation and validation perform no provider DNS lookup, provider request, quota probe, authorization creation, authorization consumption, request intent creation or transmission.
CANDIDATE_ONLY: the sole output is immutable PREPARED_NOT_AUTHORIZED evidence for a separate owner decision.
BINDER_CONTRACT_SINGLE_SOURCE: required authorization schema derives from the safe metadata export of the canonical binder contract; v1 and unknown schemas fail closed.
HISTORICAL_EVIDENCE_IMMUTABLE: the stale candidate and all ledger/quota-adjudication evidence are not modified, reused or rebound.
forbidden_side_effects: contacting or resolving The Odds API, consuming provider quota, creating provider RAW data, or starting Stage D or a scheduler
creating, consuming or reusing a live Gate 3 authorization; invoking the controlled live binder; creating a request intent; or crossing transmission
modifying historical ledger, quota adjudication, candidate or authorization evidence
self-merging, bypassing required CI/review, force-pushing or modifying main directly
reading, printing, logging, hashing or committing provider, proxy, preflight, backup or authorization secrets
